item.title: The current balance of power in open models
item.description:
📝 Open language models primarily are bucketed into two categories, open-weight and open-source models. The other prominent open-source models are also built by American non-profit organizations, including OpenAthena’s Marin models and EleutherAI’s Pythia models. Chinese open-weight models surpassed American open-weight models in these two key areas about 18 months ago.
🔗 Read more: https://www.interconnects.ai/p/the-current-balance-of-power-in-open
